No patch hunks or base text, so the changed lines can't be isolated and no regression can be shown. Reviewed visible security behavior. Native MiMo media (line ~1019) passes cacheEnabled:false, so media prefixes are never cached. Native Qwen/diffusion media caches only with an actual-feature hybridPrefixIdentity (lines 634-643), not filenames or URLs. Every error path calls releaseBox.fire() and mediaGate.release (idempotent), so reservations are not stranded (T-010/T-029 availability). Missing bridge fails loud with no silent legacy serve (T-007 and T-008 are unaffected). Unsupported-audio checks run both before acquire and after acquire. The tool-schema metadata allowance is true only for coordinator-bound engines (lines 200, 264).
